mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.order_no, p.apply_no, p.apply_id, p.purchase_date, p.purchase_status, p.contract_no, p.supplier_id, p.supplier_name, p.total_amount, p.operator_id, p.operator_name, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS apply_emp_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS apply_dept_name, COALESCE(od.dept_name, '') AS operator_dept_name, COALESCE(oe.emp_phone, '') AS operator_phone FROM asset_purchase p LEFT JOIN asset_purchase_apply_main a ON p.apply_id = a.id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON a.apply_emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON (a.apply_dept_id = CAST(d.dept_id AS CHAR) OR a.apply_dept_id = d.dept_code) LEFT JOIN sys_emp oe ON p.operator_id = oe.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept od ON (oe.dept_id = od.dept_id OR (oe.dept_code IS NOT NULL AND oe.dept_code = od.dept_code)) WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.order_no, p.apply_no, p.apply_id, p.purchase_date, p.purchase_status, p.contract_no, p.supplier_id, p.supplier_name, p.total_amount, p.operator_id, p.operator_name, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS apply_emp_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS apply_dept_name, COALESCE(od.dept_name, '') AS operator_dept_name, COALESCE(oe.emp_phone, '') AS operator_phone FROM asset_purchase p LEFT JOIN asset_purchase_apply_main a ON p.apply_id = a.id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON a.apply_emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON (a.apply_dept_id = CAST(d.dept_id AS CHAR) OR a.apply_dept_id = d.dept_code) LEFT JOIN sys_emp oe ON p.operator_id = oe.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept od ON (oe.dept_id = od.dept_id OR (oe.dept_code IS NOT NULL AND oe.dept_code = od.dept_code)) WHERE p.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT p.id, p.order_no, p.apply_no, p.apply_id, p.purchase_date, p.purchase_status, p.contract_no, p.supplier_id, p.supplier_name, p.total_amount, p.operator_id, p.operator_name, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS apply_emp_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS apply_dept_name, COALESCE(od.dept_name, '') AS operator_dept_name, COALESCE(oe.emp_phone, '') AS operator_phone FROM asset_purchase p LEFT JOIN asset_purchase_apply_main a ON p.apply_id = a.id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON a.apply_emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON (a.apply_dept_id = CAST(d.dept_id AS CHAR) OR a.apply_dept_id = d.dept_code) LEFT JOIN sys_emp oe ON p.operator_id = oe.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept od ON (oe.dept_id = od.dept_id OR (oe.dept_code IS NOT NULL AND oe.dept_code = od.dept_code)) WHERE p.apply_no = #{applyNo} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT MAX(order_no) FROM asset_purchase WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_purchase (order_no, apply_no, apply_id, purchase_date, purchase_status, contract_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, total_amount, operator_id, operator_name, remark, create_user) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{applyNo}, #{applyId}, #{purchaseDate}, #{purchaseStatus}, #{contractNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{totalAmount}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, #{createUser})
